sloka: ततो भेरीः समाजघ्नुर्मृदङ्गांश्चाप्यनादयन् ।दध्मुः शङ्खान् सम्प्रहृष्टाः क्ष्वेलन्त्यपि यथापुरम् ।। ६.५०.६२ ।।।।
transliteration: tato bherīḥ samājaghnurmṛdaṅgāṁścāpyanādayan ।dadhmuḥ śaṅkhān samprahṛṣṭāḥ kṣvelantyapi yathāpuram ।। 6.50.62 ।।।।

translations.english: Then the Vanaras played drums and even mridangams, blew conches and started jumping and leaping as before.
